note: 1.8.9 creative tabs in their index order (0-5 top row, 6-11 bottom row). Each tab lists its items in vanilla ID order ('id' = legacy block/item ID, 'meta' = data value); the Search tab shows every item sorted by (id, meta). 'item' is the LegacyCraft item (resource-pack model name); 'key' is the vanilla translation key for its display name. Membership, order and IDs are from memory of the 1.8.9 client: verify against a real creative inventory (docs/compat/unknowns.yml).
